_comment: Reference values for xtb-freq-thermo (xtb 6.7.1, GFN2-xTB opt + Hessian of ethanol, thermochemistry at 298.15 K). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: xtb 6.7.1 official grimme-lab binary release (sha256-pinned in Dockerfile), OMP_NUM_THREADS=1. 5 oracle runs produced identical values (spread 0). Lowest genuine mode 225.97 cm^-1 (threshold 50). Independent ZPE re-derivation from the agent's vibspectrum (0.5 * sum(hc*nu), 1 cm^-1 = 4.556335252912e-6 Eh) matches xtb's own ZPE to 6.7e-8 Eh (constant rounding); tol 1e-5. Cross-verify: single point on the agent's xtbopt.xyz; bit-identical, tol 1e-8 Eh.
